launches.title: Forward: The private credit network for leading debt advisors
launches.tagline: Exclusive deals to the right fund at the right moment.
launches.body:
<https://youtu.be/IEJ11354zwg>

Today we’re launching Forward to connect private credit funds with leading debt advisors.

Good deals get stuck in the wrong inboxes.

Advisors can’t know every lender. Funds can’t read every deal.

What a lender wanted last month may not be what it wants today.

Forward routes exclusive deals to the right fund at the right moment.

**A. Thesis**

For decades, private credit origination has relied on relationships, because the market was fragmented and opaque. Someone had to know which fund was suitable for each specific deal, and coordinate a complex process to secure a term sheet. That knowledge lived in people’s heads and inboxes, growing only based on headcount. 

As agentic AI crosses the viability threshold, that expensive work is now free. When labor becomes abundant, two things become scarce instead. The former is lender attention. When submitting a deal costs nothing, lenders only review deals from sources they can trust. The latter is fluid knowledge on fund mandates. A live understanding of deals a lender is looking to fund. 

Both are by-products of routing deals at scale. Forward is the private credit network for leading debt advisors. Advisors keep their borrowers and their fees. Lenders keep their credit judgment. We route the deals between them, and every deal we route sharpens our view of where capital will transact. That view is the foundation for the AI-native private credit fund we intend to build.

\
**B. Introduction**

In January 2025, the Palisades fire destroyed a three-storey office complex. Its owner had insurance and relief payments, and a plan to rebuild. What he didn’t have was a lender.

He was rejected by every bank, so he went to one of the most experienced debt advisors in California. The advisor then approached 70 lenders by hand. Nothing. 

Then he brought the deal to Forward. Within 48 hours, four lenders in our network had provided indicative terms. The transaction is now progressing to a term sheet, with the rebuild planned for early 2027. 

The lenders who fit this deal were ones whose current appetite the advisor had no way of seeing. After that deal, he became exclusive partners with Forward. 

**C. Early Evidence**

Market Validation

We lived through the pain point. Forward was born out of Sydney’s mid-market private credit industry where our founding team assessed broker-originated deals against fund mandates. We found that most of them didn’t fit. Lender attention was already the bottleneck, years before agents made sending a deal free. 

We tested whether this was one fund’s problem or intrinsic within a fractured market. We interviewed more than 30 private credit fund managers in Sydney, and every one described the same floodgate. We built an MVP in one week, got accepted into Founders Inc, and we booked a one way flight to San Francisco on 72 hour notice. 

The Cold Start

We arrived in the US in July 2026 without the comfort of a warm network but with two goals for the quarter. First, get lenders on board, and second find the advisor to anchor Forward’s platform. Within three months, 100 US funds had signed our 25 bps fee on funded loans. Concomitantly, we qualified 63 advisory firms nationwide and chose one. This got us into Y Combinator. 

The Atomic Network

We anchored the network in Southern California commercial real estate with the debt advisor above, which went exclusive after the first transaction. This month we began a controlled rollout.
